newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ITI Technologies cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ITI Technologies cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth anlayst Maureen Pettirossi said Friday she had cut her rating on ITI Technologies Inc to hold from buy after the company said its largest customer would cut back on purchase orders in the first quarter.
-- Pettirossi said she had set an earnings estimate for 1997 of $1-$1.10 a share. Her 1996 estimate remains $1.60 a share, although the loss in orders may have some impact in December, she said.
-- ITI shares were down 18-3/8 at 11-3/4, reflecting concerns over the loss of revenues and earnings, she said.

-- ITI quoted ADT Security Systems Inc, which is part of ADT Ltd, as saying it would reduce purchase orders in the first quarter. ITI said this would have a material adverse effect on its 1997 revenue and earnings. ADT Security accounted for more than 43 percent of ITI's 1996 revenues through the third quarter.
-- Pettirossi said ITI, which makes wireless security systems, has many other distribution channels, including smaller and independent dealers, and it also works with some large companies.
-- But the loss of a customer of the size of ADT Security is a concern in the short term, which is reflected in the stock, Pettirossi said.
